overloads.semanticRole: Moves or copies the values, styles, and formulas of cells from originRange to targetRange, according to options.

constraints: originRange and targetRange may refer to different 4D View Pro areas.
If originRange is a combined range, only its first sub-range is used.
options.copy defaults to False (source cells are cleared after the move); pass True to keep the source (copy instead of move).
options.pasteOptions selects what is transferred via the vk clipboard options * constants (all/formatting/formulas/values and combinations thereof); default is vk clipboard options all.
